item.text:
Created a Rust 2021 Cargo project in [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml:1) with the entry binary at [test6.rs](/output/test6.rs:1) and modular support code under [clipper2](/output/clipper2/mod.rs:1). The implementation parses `std::env::args()`, ignores arguments like the C++ program, and reimplements the used Clipper-style API (`Point64`, `Path64`, `Paths64`, `FillRule`, `Union`, `Area`, `TranslatePaths`) in [operations.rs](/output/clipper2/operations.rs:1) using only `std`.

It compiles successfully with `rustc --edition=2021 test6.rs -o test6` and with `cargo build --release`. Verified `/output/test6` matches `/workspace/dataset/test6_executable` byte-for-byte on stdout for both no arguments and extra arguments, producing `6250\n`.
